newsitem.title: USA: NYNEX says board member Reed resigns.
newsitem.headline: NYNEX says board member Reed resigns.

text.p: NYNEX Corp said board member Don Reed is resigning to become president and chief executive at Cabletron Systems Inc.
Reed's departure means he will not serve on the board of the new company formed by Bell Atlantic Corp's $23 billion acquisition of NYNEX. Each company has three seats.
Reed was president, and group executive for external affairs and corporate communications.
NYNEX said he will be succeeded by Morrison DeS. (Toby) Webb, NYNEX's general counsel, who will also be nominated to the board.

Webb joins NYNEX chairman Ivan Seidenberg and vice chairman Frederic Salerno as the three NYNEX members of the new Board. The current Bell Atlantic will be represented by that company's former chairman Raymond Smith, and vice chairmen Lawrence Babbio and James Cullen.
Webb had been scheduled to become corporate secretary of the new Bell Atlantic. That position will now be filled by Alan Bulliner, secretary of the current Bell Atlantic Corp.
